review: vol2-c final clean actual-chapter visual and numerical review

verification.calculator: PASS: default read-only recomputation matches every exported snapshot and declared variant
verification.schema: PASS: validate_lesson on all owned lessons

visual_method.paused: All PNGs inspected as native-pixel contact crops; complete figure context and full-size images used where needed. Carbon graph and every capacity lane additionally inspected in native-pixel crops for all states and profiles.
visual_method.motion: One nontrivial transition per lesson in all profiles; sampled while moving, then committed endpoint asserted. Exact elapsed times and animation current times are recorded per PNG. Source values remain visible; labels/formulas stay stationary; copy reads use docks.
visual_method.shared_primitive_grouping: Copy docks checked through lifecycle, paging, FedAvg and shadow routing; in-place execution/write through speculative verification, TinyTL and responsible-AI labels; timeline progress through carbon; append retention through time travel. Canary uses shared route/execute/reply rendering, with all its paused endpoints inspected.

closed_findings: Speculative trial/kept legend and cache creation timing are explicit; rollback keeps only valid target prefix.
Paging unused capacity retains its owner and differs from free space.
FedAvg C1-C5 labels, current trained/pending/published states and Round aggregate are coherent.
Carbon checkpointed waiting, active running, completed job and deadline cursor states match declared time. Available headroom can remain active after the job finishes.
TinyTL scalar endpoints render cleanly without floating-point tails; frozen/trained memory ownership stays visible.
Shadow completed execution counts and canary per-request output provenance are correct.

findings.observation: Unused wraps across lines in a narrow cell; owner and reserved-capacity title remain visible. No value clipping or ownership ambiguity observed.
DENIED wraps onto two lines in the desktop register face. Complete word is visible and the contiguous-run reason remains explicit.

Some generic Incoming/Update labels and compact carrier contents wrap tightly, with occasional leading glyph overlap during arrival. Retained source values, destination context and settled endpoints remain clear.

limits: No real students or learning-gain study.
One sampled in-flight instant plus settled endpoint per selected transition; not exhaustive time-continuous motion coverage.
Canary-specific motion was not separately sampled; all canary paused snapshots were inspected and shared route primitives were sampled in shadow.
Automated harness visualApproval flags remain false by design; this separate report records actual human-style visual inspection.
PNG artifacts reside in local review directories and are content-bound here by basename and SHA256.
No acceptance overlay or commit created by this reviewer.
